content:
maya: Quick design review — need eyes on playground chat controls before next deploy. Focus: streaming display, stop/regenerate UX, token counter placement, prompt library discoverability, accessibility nits.

sam: Thanks! Adding UX notes from demo. My main thought is the stop button is too hidden when streaming — it's inside the overflow and not keyboard reachable. :eyeglasses: 

oliver: Agreed. Also when you hit regenerate while streaming I'm seeing two concurrent streams in the DOM (partial + new) — that confuses screen readers. We should cancel existing request first.

lia: Copy nits: 'Stop' vs 'Cancel generation' — which is clearer for users? I prefer 'Stop' for brevity but aria-label might be 'Stop generation'.

maya: +1 on aria-label. Proposed:

```html
<button class="ctrl" aria-label="Stop generation">Stop</button>
```

and make it focusable with tabindex=0 when visible.

sam: Token counter: do we show tokens in the top-right or footer? I lean footer — less visual noise and consistent with logs. But it should be togglable and live-update while streaming.

oliver: Footer works, but we need to expose a compact mode for embed scenarios. Suggest two variants: 'compact' (token count small text) and 'detailed' (tokens + prompt length + estimated cost). Users can toggle from settings.

lia: Accessibility: color contrast for the token pill is failing WCAG AA at small sizes. Also make sure the token counter has aria-live="polite" so screen readers get updates when streaming.

maya: Good catch. Also keyboard shortcut for stop/regenerate? I propose Ctrl+K to stop, Ctrl+R to regenerate (we should avoid Cmd+R since it's browser refresh). Thoughts?

sam: Ctrl+R might conflict with browser. Maybe Shift+Enter to regenerate when focus is in input; Escape for stop. That maps to expectations from editors.

oliver: Agree Escape to stop is standard. Implement with preventDefault to avoid closing modals.

lia: Prompt library discoverability — current icon is small. Can we add a 'Templates' button next to the prompt input and a first-time tooltip? A short walkthrough card would help.

maya: Let's A/B test Templates button vs inline suggestions. Variant A: button near input. Variant B: persistent left rail entrypoint. Track clicks/activation.

sam: Minor: streaming behavior when aborted should leave last partial message visible with a faded 'incomplete' tag and a 'Regenerate' CTA. Don't collapse the content — users often copy partial outputs.

oliver: For implementation: when abort, set message.state = 'incomplete' and add meta { partial: true } — frontend can render a subtle badge.

lia: Accessibility nit: ensure any badge uses text and not only color. e.g., 'Incomplete' with small icon and aria-describedby.

maya: Very actionable. I'll update Figma and send new frames. Can someone take the accessibility checklist for this PR? @oliver?

oliver: I'll own the a11y checklist. I'll add tests for keyboard, aria-live, contrast, and screen reader flow.

sam: I'll handle token counter toggles and the compact/detailed UI.

lia: I'll do copy edits and tooltip microcopy.

design-bot: Updated Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xxxx/playground-controls-v2 — frames 3-6 updated :rocket:

maya: Thanks everyone. Targeting next sprint. If no objections I'll merge the spec by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

sam: No objections from me.

oliver: Good to go.

lia: LGTM.
